cases.prompt: Classify the parts in this scene given an empty classification_rules list
cases.expect: Infers a starting rule set from part names, presents it for confirmation, writes it to scene/config.yaml, and does not ask about the same name pattern twice in one run.

cases.prompt: One part, 'Weird_Custom_Bracket_07', matches no existing rule
